protocol_restructure_overview.description: A2A Protocol Documentation Restructure - JSON Format with Source Links
protocol_restructure_overview.original_request: Find all fields with incorrect information in docs/PROTOCOL, restructure so main folder has field bases and subfolders have nested data descriptions, convert to JSON format with links to originals/sources

docs/PROTOCOL/.purpose: Main folder with core field definitions and basic structures

files.name: fields.json
files.description: All core field definitions with types, descriptions, and source references

docs/PROTOCOL/nested/.purpose: Documents describing nested data structures with complex schemas

files.name: tasks.json
files.description: Detailed Task object structure with enum values and examples

docs/PROTOCOL/errors/.purpose: Protocol error structures and documented inconsistencies

files.name: protocol-errors.json
files.description: ProtocolError structure and documented protocol errors

docs/PROTOCOL/responses/.purpose: Complex response types and API structures

files.name: response-types.json
files.description: Message types, API responses, and RequestApiResult structures
